subject: an abstract heraldic progression/achievement emblem icon for an ARPG menu
bestPrompt: A single centered heraldic achievement medallion icon for an ARPG progression menu, in the sculpted metalwork emblem language of Path of Exile 2 and Diablo IV. Subject: one bold clean crest — a thick beveled gold ring enclosing a faceted deep-red gem dead center, flanked by two simple bold laurel branches, crowned by a small pointed finial. Deliberately BOLD chunky forms with generous negative space, minimal fine filigree, one strong shape legible at 64 pixels, frontal, dead-on symmetric. METAL art-direction: each gold ring is a distinctly modeled bevel with a warm bright highlight edge top-left, a cool bronze reflected shadow bottom-right, and a hard DARK RIM-LINE separating every ring and leaf from its neighbor and from the near-black field, so edges stay razor crisp — no mush, no blur, no soft AI gradients. The gem is hand-cut with a few large clean flat facets, hard cut-lines, dark internal walls, one small sharp specular hit. Each laurel leaf is individually sculpted with its own top highlight and deep occlusion shadow. Value read: near-black background, mid warm gold body, crisp tight highlights, maximum contrast. Hand-painted VOLUMETRIC impasto brushwork, sculpted crisp edges, AAA polish. Isolated on a plain dark slate background, sharp focus. NOT a flat vector emoji, NOT a smooth sticker, NOT a cel-shaded outline, NOT a photographic render. NO bar chart, NO graph, NO arrow, NO infographic, NO text, NO watermark, NO canvas border.
technique: The biggest lever was pivoting to BOLD chunky forms with MINIMAL fine filigree plus hard DARK RIM-LINES separating each element from a near-black field. Lucid Origin blurs fine detail (dense laurel filigree, thin engraving) into waxy AI mush, so REDUCING the amount of fine detail and forcing dark separation contours is what actually fights the mush — this jumped edgeQuality 62->74 and silhouette 72->80 and took the family from 66 to its 70 ceiling. The enabling levers, all necessary first: (1) reframe the off-brief subject as an ornate heraldic gold-and-enamel crest (shield/laurel/central gem) in explicit PoE2/D4 language, which cured the baseline's fatal literal bar-chart/arrow infographic read (styleCohesion 25->74); (2) a hard anti-infographic + anti-vector negative tail (NO bar chart/graph/arrow/infographic + NOT a flat vector emoji/sticker/cel-shaded outline) held cleanliness at 88-95; (3) named lighting art-direction (single key light, warm highlight / cool reflected shadow, deep occlusion between leaves) plus a designed near-black-to-highlight value ramp. Counter-lesson: pushing HARDER metal specular or gem-facet detail (i5, i6) did NOT climb — Lucid renders gold as a semi-matte color-blob and gems with a blown-out uniform highlight regardless of art-direction, so materialRendering/gem fidelity are a hard cap, not a prompt-solvable axis.

iterations.note: Heraldic gilded-crest recipe (shield + laurel + central ruby) in PoE2/D4 language, anti-vector + anti-infographic negatives, named lighting. Cured the fatal bar-chart read: styleCohesion 25->66, cleanliness 92, off the floor 33->61. Judge: gold flat, ruby muddy, laurel AI-mush.

Added explicit lighting art-direction — hard upper-left key light, sharp gold specular hotspots, cool rim, deep leaf occlusion, faceted ruby with cullet highlight. material 56->70, edge 58->63. Judge: uniform yellow + blown-out specular blooms flatten form.

Controlled three-tone gold ramp (cool bronze shadow / warm mid / thin crisp rim), forbade blown-out blooms, forged hammered texture, hand-varied leaves. Plateaued — identical dims. Judge: still flat yellow color-blob, mushy edges, banded bezel.

BEST. Pivot to BOLD chunky forms + minimal filigree + hard DARK RIM-LINES separating each ring/leaf from a near-black field. edge 62->74, silhouette 72->80, cleanliness 95. Fewer fine details to mush was the winning move. Remaining cap: material 64 (gold matte-blob), gem plastic.

Kept bold forms, pushed HARD metallic specular (anisotropic streaks) + separated wreath into a darker value plane behind the ring. Value layers read but the gem worsened to a lumpy blob and material stayed matte — regressed. Confirms harder-specular language doesn't lift Lucid's metal.

i4 bold-form recipe + gem-coherence fix (single 8-point star ruby, one key-light, dark internal facet walls). Lucid still produced a blown-out uniform gem highlight and semi-matte gold — heavy per-gen variance, no climb past i4. Reverted to i4 as winner.

ceiling: ~70, model-capped for this family. 90 is NOT reachable via prompt alone. Composition, on-brief heraldic identity, silhouette and cleanliness were fully solvable by prompt (styleCohesion 25->74, silhouette ->80, cleanliness ->95), but the two ceiling axes — materialRendering (64-70: Lucid renders gold as a semi-matte color-blob with weak specular story) and gem/facet fidelity (blown-out uniform highlight, incoherent facets) — did NOT respond to three successive rounds of deliberate metal/gem art-direction (i2, i3, i5, i6 all stalled at 66 while i4 hit 70 by REMOVING detail, not adding rendering direction). Combined with Lucid's large per-gen variance (i4=70 vs i6=66 from near-identical bold-form recipes), this family sits in the same 61-72 band as the sibling hud-ui-glyphs (61) and ability-fx-icons (72) families. The real fix is model/tooling (a stronger metal renderer or vector/relief compositing), not further prompt work.
